armor.interpretation: Tracking early probes did not settle elevation before release. Fixed future-aim pair is recorded separately. Body damage confirms a hit; armor300-to0 alone is not a confirmed absorption event because natural expiry also clears it. No universal multiplier or invulnerability claimed.

recommendations.title: 西侧高柱下落斩
recommendations.description: 队友压住中路时，从高台挂西侧高柱，边落边纵斩，再横斩收侧路。

recommendations.title: 东侧墙点，落地补刀
recommendations.description: 从右路内侧挂高墙，纵斩压外侧通路，落地后横斩收尾，别在墙上久留。

recommendations.title: 高台前矮墙起跳
recommendations.description: 上钩后小跳，再用纵斩接横斩压高台；本轮只验证了这套输入，别直接省掉小跳。

binding_gate: Native bind witness plus world anchor within2.5u of selected point. Point-neighbourhood validation, not same mesh-triangle proof. Both normals retained; swept contact normal differs near edges; actor ID alone insufficient.
combo_gate: nearby expected anchor, 100HP before charge, native70 decrease then later KO; prior special contact damage excluded
rate_semantics: Observed trial fractions and unique-point counts at N1–2. Not a real-combat success probability.
